# Auditplus Dart Pdf Server





# Commands:

#### Create New Project
* dart create -t console dart_pdf_server

#### Used Packages
* dart pub add args

#### Run Project
* cd .\dart_pdf_server\
* dart run

#### Compile to executable
* dart compile exe bin/dart_pdf_server.dart
* dart_pdf_server\bin> ./dart_pdf_server



dart run bin/dart_pdf_server.dart -t '' -d '{\"name\":\"aplus\"}'
